Greedy Meshing - GitHub
Apr 17, 2026Greedy Meshing A client-side Fabric mod that optimizes chunk rendering by merging adjacent identical block faces into larger quads using greedy meshing. This reduces the number of quads the GPU needs to render, improving frame rates in areas with large flat surfaces of the same block.
